spans.text: patients' cerebral metabolism (FDG‐PET)
a factorial design

To explore the brain changes specifically associated with impaired autonoetic consciousness in bv‐FTD, we created a factorial design including the PET images of the control group, a subgroup of four bv‐FTD patients with poor Remember scores (as measured by low Remember scores compared to controls, i.e., 1.5 standard deviations from the controls' mean), and a subgroup of four bv‐FTD patients with high Remember scores (within the normal range).

description.value: An episodic feeling-of-knowing task involving study of cue-target word pairs, cued recall with feeling-of-knowing judgments, and a five-alternative forced-choice recognition phase with Remember/Know/Guess judgments.

instructions.value: Participants studied cue-target pairs, attempted to recall the target for each cue, predicted whether they would recognize unrecalled targets, and judged recognized items as Remember, Know, or Guess.

stimuli.value: Forty target French words, each paired with a weakly associated cue word; twenty pairs were presented during the task.
